summary: Nginx is installed, enabled at boot, and serving HTTP successfully on TCP port 6700 across all four nodes. Each node was restarted individually and recovered with a changed boot identity and HTTP 200 response.
actions_performed: Installed Nginx on AlmaLinux node1/node2 and Alpine node3/node4.
Configured node-specific index pages and listeners on IPv4/IPv6 TCP 6700.
Configured SELinux and firewalld persistence on the AlmaLinux nodes.
Enabled Nginx through systemd on AlmaLinux and OpenRC on Alpine.
Restarted exactly one node at a time and verified recovery before proceeding.
Completed final configuration, service, boot-enablement, and HTTP 200 checks on every node.

evidence.requirement: Nginx serves / successfully over HTTP on TCP 6700 on all nodes
